description: This is a minimalist white bar stool with a gently contoured seat designed for comfort. It features four tapered legs that angle outward for stability, connected by two horizontal braces that provide additional support and create a footrest. The simple, clean lines and absence of a backrest give it a modern and airy appearance. The entire stool is rendered in a smooth, matte white finish, making it versatile and easy to integrate into various decor styles. Its design prioritizes functionality and a sleek aesthetic.
